definition: a Surface Form is one spelling of a word. the Lexicon contains every Surface Form of the language. the Lexicon gives one Form Tag to every Surface Form.
a Lemma is one entry of the Seed. a Lemma is the base spelling of a word. Lexgen expands every Lemma into the Surface Forms of the Lemma.
a Category is the class of a Lemma. people choose one Category for every Lemma. the Category decides the Surface Forms of the Lemma.
a Form Tag names the class of one Surface Form. every Surface Form has one Form Tag. the Form Tag comes from the Category of the Lemma.
the Seed is the file "seed/seed.json". people edit the Seed. every entry of the Seed names one Lemma. the entry names the Category of the Lemma. Lexgen builds the Lexicon from the Seed.
the Lexicon is the file "lexicon.tsv". Lexgen writes the Lexicon from the Seed. the Lexicon contains every Surface Form and contains every Redirect. people do not edit the Lexicon.
a Paradigm contains every Surface Form of one Lemma. Lexgen builds the Paradigm of a Lemma from the Category of the Lemma.
if 2 Lemmas produce one Surface Form, then the Surface Form is a Collision. if one Surface Form has 2 Form Tags, then the Surface Form is a Collision. Lexgen rejects every Collision.
a Redirect names a replacement for a Rejected Sense of a word. the Linter shows the Redirect to the writer.
the maintainers can waive the Redirect of a Rejected Sense. the Waiver records the choice.

if the Lexicon contains every word of a sentence, then the Coverage counts the sentence. the Coverage is a share of the corpus. the Coverage is a proxy. the Coverage does not measure the quality of the Redirects.
if the Linter does not parse a sentence, then the sentence is a Rejection. a Rejection is a Ban or is a Gap. the Linter must explain every Rejection.
a Ban is a Rejection of an ambiguous structure. the Ban is permanent. the writer changes the sentence. the Linter explains the Ban.
a Translation Pair has an original sentence and has a translation. the Linter must parse the translation. the translation must keep every claim of the original sentence.

a translation can drop the politeness of the original sentence. a translation can drop the emphasis of the original sentence. the Translation Pair must declare every loss. a Declared Loss is a declaration of a loss. a translation cannot drop a claim.
the Linter checks a sentence. the Linter parses the sentence or explains the Rejection. the Linter names the kind of a Rejection.
the Grammar defines every Sentence Shape of the language. the Grammar gives one Parse to every sentence.
a Sentence Shape is a structure of a sentence. the Grammar defines every Sentence Shape. every sentence of the language uses one Sentence Shape.
a Parse is one structure of a sentence. every sentence of the language has one Parse.
an Anaphoric Pronoun refers to a noun of a prior sentence. the reader must find the noun. the language bans every Anaphoric Pronoun. the writer repeats the noun.
an Indexical Pronoun refers to the writer or refers to the reader. the pronoun "i" is an Indexical Pronoun. the pronoun "you" is an Indexical Pronoun. the language allows Indexical Pronouns.
a Discourse Layer resolves the referent of an Anaphoric Pronoun. the language does not have a Discourse Layer.
if a reader cannot find the referent of a pronoun, then the sentence has a Reference Ambiguity. the design of the language removes every Reference Ambiguity.
a Function Word is a word of a Closed Class. a Function Word has one meaning. the Grammar gives one meaning to every Function Word.
Minglish is the language of the project. every sentence of Minglish has one Parse.
Lexgen is a tool. Lexgen builds the Lexicon from the Seed. Lexgen rejects every Collision.
Triage is a tool. Triage measures the Coverage of the Lexicon.
WordNet is a database. WordNet attests the senses of the words.
people curate the Seed. people choose every Lemma.
the Linter lints a sentence. the Linter checks the words and checks the structure.
the Linter parses a sentence. the Linter finds the Parse of the sentence.
the maintainers waive the Redirect of a Rejected Sense. the Waiver records the choice.
the data attests the words. if the data does not attest a Surface Form, then Lexgen rejects the Surface Form.
an anaphoric word refers to a noun of a prior sentence.
an indexical word refers to the writer or refers to the reader.
a transitive verb needs an object.
an intransitive verb does not need an object.
a Rejected Sense is a sense of a word. the Seed does not enable the Rejected Sense. the Linter rejects the Rejected Sense. a Rejected Sense has a Redirect or has a Waiver.
a Gap is a Rejection of a good sentence. the language cannot say the sentence. the maintainers fix a Gap with a decision.
a Closed Class contains Function Words. a Closed Class does not grow. people cannot add a word to a Closed Class.

an Enumeration is a block. the block has a statement. the block has a list of the items. the statement ends with a colon. every item names one thing. the items enumerate the last Noun Phrase of the statement.
a Noun Phrase names one thing. a Noun Phrase has a noun or is a quoted word.
